name: Cambero Metal Works
old_description: Our custom fabrication services allow you to bring your unique designs to life, using high-quality materials tailored to your specifications.​
about:
Cambero Metal Works was founded in 2003 by Virginia and Angel Cambero in a garage in San Gabriel, California. The family-owned and operated shop began with a set of tools and a commitment to craftsmanship, growing into a full-service custom fabrication facility serving clients across Southern California.

The company provides custom metal fabrication including precision CNC laser cutting, TIG/MIG/stick welding, sheet metal forming, rolling, and stainless steel finishing. Its capabilities span stainless steel fabrication for commercial kitchens, architectural metalwork such as handrails and decorative panels, structural steel assemblies, and custom sheet metal components in stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, galvanized metal, and copper. The shop combines hand-sketching and CAD/Inventor design with modern fabrication technology.

Cambero serves industrial, commercial, and residential sectors, with specific experience in transit, rail, and government projects. Its client base includes architects, contractors, designers, restaurant owners, and kitchen designers throughout Southern California. Projects range from commercial kitchen equipment and ventilation systems to structural installations and ornamental metalwork.

The founders emphasize honest craftsmanship, personal attention, and a quality standard unchanged over two decades. The company states that its differentiator lies in treating each project with the same care as its own business, blending old-world craftsmanship with modern tools to deliver work that holds up long after completion.

name: Camgian
old_description: Camgian was founded in Starkville, Mississippi, establishing its roots in advanced technology and defense innovation.
about:
Camgian was founded in 2006 in Starkville, Mississippi, by Dr. Gary Butler, establishing its roots in advanced technology and defense innovation. The company began as a venture focused on artificial intelligence and machine learning for high-stakes environments.

Today, Camgian develops AI-enabled kill chain automation software, most notably its REACTOR® platform, which provides cognitive decision aids for air and missile defense, counter-unmanned aircraft systems, and space defense. The software is hardware- and command-and-control-agnostic, built on a modular, open architecture that leverages reinforcement learning, multi-modal sensor fusion, and real-time sensor cueing. The firm operates from its Mississippi headquarters and additional offices in Tuscaloosa and Lawton, Oklahoma, with a new facility opened in Huntsville, Alabama in 2025.

Camgian serves primarily U.S. Department of Defense organizations, including the Missile Defense Agency and the U.S. Army. In 2024 it secured a $55 million contract to support the Army's Integrated Air and Missile Defense systems, and it holds a position on the MDA's $151 billion SHIELD IDIQ contract vehicle. Its solutions are also offered to select non-DoD government entities and commercial partners.

The company states its mission is to accelerate decision-making in high-stakes environments by reducing cognitive overload and delivering precision at the point of decision. Its stated differentiators include platform-agnostic deployment, open-architecture scalability, and a culture rooted in radical accountability and a "No Quit" mindset.

name: Canyon Ridge Communications
old_description: Canyon Ridge Communications is your supplier for the highest quality pagers available.
about:
Canyon Ridge Communications operates from Las Vegas, Nevada. The company has been active since at least 2005, as indicated by its copyright notice, and is incorporated as Canyon Ridge Communications, Inc. No founders or ownership structure beyond incorporation are disclosed publicly.

The company specializes in the refurbished Motorola pager market, supplying Keynote, Alpha, and Numeric pager models. The Alpha line includes the Advisor Gold, Advisor Pro, Advisor, and Memo Express; the Numeric line includes the Bravo Classic, Bravo Plus, and Bravo LX. Refurbished units are delivered in new original Motorola housings with holsters where applicable, and the company supports most bandsplit requirements. It also stocks Motorola and A/M replacement parts for repair and refurbishment work.

The company does not specify target industries or customer types in its public materials. Its pager products and parts are typically used in sectors such as healthcare, emergency services, and industrial communications, though no explicit customer examples are provided.

Canyon Ridge Communications emphasizes pride in offering the highest quality refurbished Motorola pagers, differentiating itself through the use of new original Motorola housings and broad bandsplit support.

name: Capital City Salvage
old_description: We have an advanced online inventory system with fast nationwide shipping.
about:
Capital City Salvage operates from Johnston, Rhode Island, where it runs an auto salvage business focused on late-model foreign and domestic vehicles. The company maintains a large inventory of used auto, truck, and SUV parts for customers across the country.

The business stocks thousands of components ranging from front ends, doors, hoods, and fenders to engines, transmissions, transfer cases, and rear axle assemblies. The inventory also includes mechanical parts such as alternators, starters, A/C compressors, cylinder heads, steering gears, axle shafts, control arms, and mirrors, as well as body panels and lighting. An advanced online inventory system lets buyers search by year, make, model, and part type, and orders are shipped nationwide either by the company's own associates or via UPS.

The parts supply serves automotive repair shops, collision centers, and vehicle owners needing replacement components for late-model cars and trucks. Extended warranties are offered on most parts purchased.

The company emphasizes its online search capability and fast shipping as key advantages, allowing customers to locate and receive parts quickly without visiting a physical yard.

name: Captron Electronics Assembly
old_description: If you just have an idea or concept or you have completed schematics, we can convert them in to manufacturable design files followed by PCB manufacturing, Assembly and Testing.
about:
CapTron Corporation was established in 1997 in Gaithersburg, Maryland. The company began as an electronic manufacturing services provider focused on printed circuit boards, assemblies, and complete systems.

The shop offers a full turnkey suite: PCB design and layout, fabrication of single-sided, double-sided, and multi-layer boards for analog, digital, and RF applications, and PCB assembly with part procurement, programming, BGA placement with X-ray inspection, and functional testing. It also produces custom cable assemblies, box builds, and enclosure machining. CapTron handles quick-turn prototypes through production quantities, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Customers span communications device manufacturers, internet service providers, automotive component makers, and RF technology firms. The company works with OEMs and other businesses needing flexible, responsive electronic contract manufacturing.

CapTron emphasizes flexible service, firm up-front pricing, straight talk, and ethical practices. It avoids one-size-fits-all solutions, instead developing customized programs for each client. Quality is positioned as non-negotiable, with no shortcuts that compromise solder joints or component placement.

old_description: My system has been in for 11 months and has dramatically reduced my electric bill. The only "system maintenance" has been software upgrades by the manufacturer of the inverter.
about:
Carbon Recall Tupelo operates from Belden, Mississippi, serving the Tupelo area as a local solar and home energy company. The business operates under the Carbon Recall® brand and emphasizes its community roots, describing itself as a neighborhood team of mothers, fathers, friends, and neighbors working toward energy independence. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The company installs rooftop solar arrays and Smartflower® all-in-one solar systems, along with solar water heating, home battery storage, backup generators, EV charging stations, LED lighting, geothermal HVAC, and tankless water heating. It also provides whole-home energy efficiency assessments. All installations are performed by a team described as trained renewable energy experts, though facility size, headcount, and annual project volumes are not published.

Customers include both residential and commercial clients. Homeowners seek to lower or eliminate electric bills, with one testimonial noting a 60% reduction in grid energy needs after 11 months. Businesses are targeted for clean energy savings. The company assists with financing options, tax credits, and incentive programs to reduce upfront costs.

Carbon Recall Tupelo positions its differentiation on a community-first approach and comprehensive service bundle, stating it aims to make solar easy by handling design, permitting, installation, and incentive paperwork. The brand motto “Together, we improve lives®” reflects a stated mission to shape the future of energy one rooftop at a time.

name: Cardinal Electronics
old_description: 50+ Years of Electronics Repair in Louisville and Kentuckiana
about:
Founded in 1974, Cardinal Electronics has operated from Fairdale, Kentucky for over five decades, serving the Louisville metropolitan area and surrounding counties including Bullitt, Meade, Hardin, and Spencer. The business began as a local television repair shop and gradually expanded its service lineup to match evolving consumer electronics.

Today the shop specializes in consumer electronics repair, handling television sets, laptop and desktop computers, home stereo systems, and radios. Technicians diagnose and fix issues ranging from fuzzy pictures and power failures to virus infections and hardware damage. In addition to repair services, the company stocks reconditioned televisions, laptops, and desktop computers that have been inspected for resale, offering an affordable alternative to new purchases.

Cardinal Electronics primarily serves residential customers throughout the Kentuckiana region who need quick restoration of their personal devices. Walk-in clients bring equipment to the Mitchell Hill Road facility, while phone consultations provide preliminary estimates. The service area covers both urban Louisville neighborhoods and the more rural communities of the adjacent counties.

The business emphasizes fast turnaround times and backs its repairs with a warranty, aiming to return devices promptly at what it describes as fair and reasonable rates. Its longevity in the market is cited as a sign of consistent service quality, with the owner noting that over 50 years of experience informs every repair job.

name: Carina Inc
old_description: We are highly experienced, private label, garment manufacturers specializing in leather + shearling production in NYC.
about:
Carina Inc operates from New York City's Garment District at 242 West 38th Street. After opening a first facility with a partner in 1973, Sabetay branched out on his own to create Carina New York, and his daughter Paula Stvan joined the following year. The business remains family-owned and operated.

The company provides private-label garment manufacturing with a focus on leather, shearling, and denim. Its in-house factory offers three service tiers: cut-and-sew only (client supplies patterns and materials), cut-and-sew with pattern development and grading, and full-service production that includes pattern work, muslin prototypes, fittings, material sourcing, and final assembly. Production minimums start at 50 pieces, though they vary for denim and cotton programs.

Carina serves fashion brands ranging from startups to established labels, producing apparel, outerwear, sportswear, ready-to-wear, runway pieces, bespoke items, accessories, and home goods. The client roster includes recognizable designer labels, though specific names are not disclosed.

The firm emphasizes craftsmanship, attention to detail, and on-time delivery as hallmarks of its family legacy. It also runs an upcycling program that turns fabric scraps into accessories, embellishments, and small home goods, offering brands an environmentally conscious production option.
